## On-call handoff — gateway 503s

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) — "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation." It flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Connections stopped being reused, and the 20-slot pool filled up permanently.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:14 UTC to at least 03:59 UTC (still ongoing at end of log). First error: `req-07401` at 02:14:18, `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**What broke:** Every route through the gateway — `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search` — across all four upstreams (billing, orders, catalog, accounts). Pool stayed maxed at 20/20 in use, with the waiting queue climbing from 13 to 74+ over the window.

**Not affected:** Workers (`worker.log`) stayed healthy the whole time. No 503s, no pool errors there.

**Rollback:** Revert `dep-4471` on the gateway — set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`.
